introTr: Bu, programın yarısındaki kontrol noktan. Hedef 39 ve üzeri; ama asıl amaç, hangi konuların oturduğunu ve hangilerine tekrar gerektiğini görmek. Yavaş oku, bilmediğini işaretle, sonra sonuç ekranındaki tekrar önerilerine bak.

items.q: If it rains tomorrow, the field trip ___.
items.whyTr: Gerçekçi gelecek durumu: If + geniş zaman, will + fiil (burada edilgen).

items.q: If I ___ time tomorrow, I'll visit the library.
items.whyTr: If cümleciğinde gelecek için geniş zaman kullanılır.

items.q: If I were the principal, I ___ more field trips.
items.whyTr: Gerçek dışı durum: If + geçmiş zaman, would + fiil.

items.q: Students can't leave the room ___ they have a hall pass.
items.whyTr: Unless = if ... not; 'geçiş kartı yoksa' anlamı verir.

items.q: If the fire alarm rings, all students ___ the building quietly.
items.whyTr: Genel kural (zero conditional): If + geniş zaman, geniş zaman.

items.q: Lunch ___ in the cafeteria at 11:30.
items.whyTr: Yemeği servis eden değil, servis edilen önemli: is served.

items.q: The new gym ___ last year.
items.whyTr: Geçmişte yapılmış bir şey: was built.

items.q: The reports ___ by the teachers every Friday.
items.whyTr: Düzenli iş, edilgen: are written.

items.q: The teacher ___ helped me yesterday is very kind.
items.whyTr: Kişiyi tanımlarken who kullanılır.

items.q: This is the room ___ the students eat lunch.
items.whyTr: Yer için where kullanılır.

items.q: Ms. Carter, ___ daughter attends my school, is on the committee.
items.whyTr: Sahiplik için whose kullanılır.

items.q: The book ___ I borrowed from the library is excellent.
items.whyTr: Nesne için which kullanılır.

items.q: I enjoy ___ with young children.
items.whyTr: Enjoy'dan sonra fiil -ing alır.

items.q: She decided ___ for the substitute teacher job.
items.whyTr: Decide'dan sonra to + fiil gelir.

items.q: I'm saving money ___ buy a car next year.
items.whyTr: Amaç bildirmek için to + fiil.

items.q: She is studying every day ___ she can pass the test.
items.whyTr: So that + özne + can/will: amaç cümleciği.

items.q: Could you tell me ___ the office opens?
items.whyTr: Kibar soruda düz cümle sırası: what time the office opens.

items.q: Do you know if ___ a pencil I could borrow?
items.whyTr: Dolaylı soruda 'if' sonrası düz cümle sırası.

items.q: She asked me where ___.
items.whyTr: Aktarılan soruda düz cümle sırası ve geçmişe kayma: where I lived.

items.q: If I had known about the sub plans, I ___ them earlier.
items.whyTr: Geçmişteki gerçek dışı durum: If + had V3, would have V3.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'assist'?
items.whyTr: Assist ve help aynı anlama gelir.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'absent'?
items.whyTr: Absent (yok) kelimesinin zıttı present (mevcut).

items.q: 'Teachers take attendance every morning.' Attendance is:
options: a record of who is present
items.whyTr: Attendance, yoklama kaydıdır.

items.q: 'A substitute teacher takes the place of the regular teacher.' A substitute is:
items.whyTr: Substitute, başkasının yerini alan kişidir.

items.q: Please ___ attention to the instructions.
items.whyTr: 'Pay attention' dikkat etmek demektir.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'increase'?
items.whyTr: Increase (artmak) kelimesinin zıttı decrease (azalmak).

items.q: Which word means the same as 'essential'?
items.whyTr: Essential ve necessary: gerekli.

items.q: 'The principal wants to improve school safety.' Improve means:
items.whyTr: Improve, geliştirmek, daha iyi yapmak demektir.

items.q: 'The teacher praised the students' good behavior.' Behavior means:
items.whyTr: Behavior, davranış demektir.

items.q: 'Hafsa has strong communication skills.' Communication means:
items.whyTr: Communication, iletişim kurmak, bilgi paylaşmak demektir.

items.q: 'The school has a strict policy about phones.' A policy is:
items.whyTr: Policy, resmî kural veya politika demektir.

items.q: 'The students were enthusiastic about the trip.' Enthusiastic means:
items.whyTr: Enthusiastic, istekli ve heyecanlı demektir.

passages.title: Who does what at Lincoln Elementary?
passages.text:
At Lincoln Elementary, many people work together every day. The principal, Dr. Lopez, is the person who makes the big decisions. Mr. Brown is the school secretary who answers the phone and keeps the student records. The nurse's office is the place where students go when they feel sick.

Ms. Carter, whose classroom is on the second floor, teaches fourth grade. The custodian is the man who cleans the building and checks that the doors are locked at night. The cafeteria, which is next to the gym, opens at 11:00 for lunch.

Hafsa is learning everyone's name because she wants to feel like part of the team.

questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'Mr. Brown is the school secretary who ... keeps the student records.'
Metinde: 'The nurse's office is the place where students go when they feel sick.'
Metinde: 'The cafeteria, which is next to the gym'.

passages.title: Why Hafsa wants to teach
passages.text:
Hafsa enjoys helping people learn. When she was a girl in Isparta, her English teacher encouraged her to keep studying, and she decided to become a teacher herself. In Turkey she taught small groups of children, but she stopped after moving to the United States because she needed to improve her own English first.

Now she studies every day in order to pass the placement test. If she passes, she will be able to take the substitute teacher course. She hopes to work as a substitute next fall so that she can see different grades before choosing a permanent job.

If she could choose any job in the world, she would teach English to new immigrants. She knows exactly how difficult the first year in a new country can be.

questions.q: Who encouraged Hafsa to keep studying English?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'her English teacher encouraged her to keep studying'.

questions.q: Why is Hafsa studying every day?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'in order to pass the placement test'.

questions.q: What will Hafsa be able to do if she passes the test?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'If she passes, she will be able to take the substitute teacher course.'

questions.q: What would Hafsa's dream job be?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'she would teach English to new immigrants'.

passages.title: Safety at school
passages.text:
Every school has safety rules. At Lincoln Elementary, the doors are locked at 8:30 every morning, and visitors must sign in at the front office. Fire drills are practiced once a month. If the alarm rings, students line up and leave the building quietly. Teachers carry the attendance list so that they can check that everyone is outside.

Unless there is a real emergency, no one goes back inside until the principal gives permission. Substitute teachers are given a folder with the evacuation map and the class list, so they know what to do. 'If you read the folder in the morning, you won't feel lost,' Mr. Brown tells new substitutes.

questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'the doors are locked at 8:30 every morning'.

questions.q: Why do teachers carry the attendance list during a fire drill?
options: To give it to the principal
To check that everyone is outside
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'so that they can check that everyone is outside'.

questions.q: What is a substitute teacher given?
options: A folder with the evacuation map and class list
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'a folder with the evacuation map and the class list'.

script.speaker: Dr. Lopez
script.text: Why do you want to be a substitute teacher, Hafsa?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I like working with children, and I want to learn how American schools work.

script.speaker: Dr. Lopez
script.text: What do you enjoy most about teaching?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I enjoy explaining new things. I also love seeing a student finally understand.

script.speaker: Dr. Lopez
script.text: What would you do if two students started arguing in class?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I would separate them first. Then I would talk to each of them quietly, and if the problem continued, I would call the office.

script.speaker: Dr. Lopez
script.text: Good answer. Do you have any questions for me?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. Could you tell me how substitutes find out about jobs?

script.speaker: Dr. Lopez
script.text: We use an app, which sends a message early in the morning.

questions.q: What does Hafsa enjoy most about teaching?
What would Hafsa do first if two students argued?
How do substitutes find out about jobs?
options: They read an email at night.
An app sends them a message.
questions.whyTr: Dr. Lopez: 'We use an app, which sends a message early in the morning.'

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good morning. Could you tell me what time school starts?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Students arrive at 8:15, and classes begin at 8:30.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you. Do you know if substitutes need to bring lunch?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: You can buy lunch in the cafeteria, or you can bring your own.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: One more question. Could you tell me where I should park?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Behind the gym. The front lot is for parents, unless you have a permit.

questions.q: What can substitutes do about lunch?
options: Buy it in the cafeteria or bring their own
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'buy lunch in the cafeteria, or ... bring your own'.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Our field trip is on Friday. If it rains, we'll go to the museum instead of the zoo.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: What will we do if the bus is late?

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: We'll wait inside. If we had a bigger bus, we would take both classes, but we only have one.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: So the other class stays at school?

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Yes, unless the principal finds another bus.

questions.q: Where will the class go if it rains?
questions.whyTr: Ms. Carter: 'If it rains, we'll go to the museum'.

options: There is only one small bus.
questions.whyTr: Ms. Carter: 'If we had a bigger bus ... we only have one.'

writing.promptTr: Mülakat hazırlığı: 'Neden substitute teacher olmak istiyorsun?' sorusuna yazılı cevap ver (80-120 kelime). Deneyimini, nedenini ve bir 'if' cümlesiyle bir durumda ne yapacağını anlat.
writing.promptEn: Interview practice: Why do you want to be a substitute teacher? Write 80-120 words. Mention your experience, your reasons, and what you would do in one classroom situation (use an if-sentence).
checklistTr: Neden sorusuna cevap verdim mi (because / in order to / so that)?
Deneyimimi anlattım mı (I taught ... / I have volunteered ...)?
En az bir 'If I ..., I would ...' veya 'If ..., I will ...' cümlesi yazdım mı?
Bir ilgi cümleciği kullandım mı (who / which / where)?
Enjoy + -ing ve decide / want + to doğru mu?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve nokta ile bitiyor mu?
writing.model: I want to be a substitute teacher because I enjoy helping children learn. I taught English in Turkey for two years, and I have volunteered at Lincoln Elementary for six months. I am studying English every day so that I can work confidently in an American classroom. I am patient, organized and friendly. If two students started arguing, I would separate them and talk to each one quietly. If the problem continued, I would call the office. I believe that a calm teacher is a teacher who can help every student.
